$comment: All copy for the banner, featured-work cards and social previews. Edit text here, then run `npm run build`. Image paths are relative to this file; the sibling repos are expected next to this one (../bestdecks, ../slideshow-renderer, ...). Keep volatile numbers (test counts, P&L) off the cards.
author: Nadimul Haque

banner.name: Nadi Haque
banner.subline: Data and product engineer  ·  New York

cards.name: bestdecks
cards.line: Drafts a tailored deck per target company, then blocks delivery if any factual claim can't be matched to retained source text.

cards.name: remi-intake-engine
cards.line: Turns memos, rent rolls and email threads into reviewed facts, then flags where documents disagree, down to the cell or line.

cards.name: kalshi-vol-edge
cards.line: Kalshi BTC bracket trading with a live model dashboard, exchange-as-truth reconciliation, and post-mortems on what the live data showed.

cards.name: slideshow-renderer
cards.line: A one-line topic becomes validated slide copy, edited in a local studio and rendered to 9:16 video with Remotion. Works with free LLM keys.
